units.source_text: 这是从去年开始举办的盛事，千重子去观看了。

en.t: This was a grand event that had been held since the previous year, and Chieko went to watch it.

units.source_text: 本来在王朝公卿前头的是歌人吉井勇（这位吉井勇已与世长辞，不在人世了）。

en.t: Originally, standing before the court nobles of the imperial age was the poet Isamu Yoshii, though Yoshii had already passed away and was no longer in this world.
